articles.title: Fortnite: Override Is Here!
articles.body: Break the rules. Change the game! Activate Overrides to switch up the game and explore areas inspired by gaming legends like Sonic, Tetris, and Pac-Man as the future of the Island unfolds.

articles.title: The Horror Is Here
articles.body: A cursed cartridge is spreading through the Island, corrupting everything it touches. Step into Battle Royale to see what hair-raising horrors await, including powerful new weapons, terrifying mechanics, horrifying bosses, and more!

articles.title: Five Nights at Freddy's Gameplay
articles.body: It's showtime! Face down animatronic bosses in Battle Royale, with one always lurking at Freddy Fazbear's Pizza Parlor. Defeat any rogue robot you find to possess the suit and finish the fight Fazbear style.

articles.title: Keep Collecting and Mastering
articles.body: There are all new Sprites to discover and collect! Extract and equip them for game-changing Sprite Powers, level them up, and keep growing the Collection in Override. Sprites will now appear in Ranked too, with abilities disabled to maintain even competition.

articles.title: Earn the Peril Peak Mali Style
articles.body: Gifting the Override Battle Pass unlocks the Peril Peak Mali Style and matching accessories for both the gifter and the friend receiving it!
